params.text: Supabase Production Database Audit: mailofly | PostgreSQL 17.6 (aarch64) | Ref: aymarrhbnaygxkaorjfl

params.name: Desc
params.text:
• Multi-Tenancy Boundary:
  The `organizations` table acts as the master multi-tenant anchor. All customer data (contacts, campaigns, emails, mailboxes, domains) is strictly partitioned by organization_id.

• Email Dispatch & AWS SES Ingestion:
  High-volume transactional and marketing email pipeline. Webhook events stream into `ses_event_inbox`, recorded in `ses_event_log`, and update `ses_recipient_outcomes`.

• Drip & Event Automation:
  Automations workflow system (automations, automation_runs, automation_run_steps, automation_events) drives behavioral email sequences.

• Audience & CRM:
  Rich contact model with dynamic segmentation (segment_contacts), custom properties (contact_property_values), and subscription state.

params.name: Desc
params.text:
• public Schema: 104 Base Tables, 7 Views, 224 Functions, 119 Enums
  Contains the complete application domain (tenancy, campaigns, contacts, billing).

• auth Schema: 27 Tables
  Managed by Supabase GoTrue (users, identities, sessions, mfa_factors, refresh_tokens).

• storage Schema: 10 Tables
  Supabase Storage engine (buckets, objects, s3_multipart_uploads).

• realtime Schema: 10 Tables
  Realtime broadcast, presence, and change data capture subscriptions.

• extensions & cron Schemas: 6 Tables
  pg_cron scheduled jobs (mail queue crons) and vault secret keys.

params.text: Table sizing analysis, index coverage audit, and 59 foreign key indexing opportunities

params.name: Title
params.text: ⚠️ Missing Indexes on Foreign Keys (59 Found)

params.name: Sub
params.text: Foreign keys lacking dedicated B-tree indexes cause sequential table scans on deletes and joins.

params.name: Notes
params.text:
1. Index Unindexed Foreign Keys [HIGH]:
   Adding indexes on high-frequency tables (e.g. campaign_run_audience, automation_events) prevents full sequential scans during cascading deletes.

2. Log Table Archiving / Retention [MEDIUM]:
   ses_event_log and api_key_request_logs account for >40% of database storage despite low row counts. Implement a 30-day or 90-day retention partition.

3. Autovacuum Tuning [LOW]:
   Dead tuple accumulation is normal on event queue tables (ses_event_inbox). Ensure autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor is set to 0.05 for queue tables.

params.name: Page Container: Security & Row Level Security (RLS) Audit
Page Subtitle
params.text: Audit of 104 RLS-enabled public tables, 219 active policies, and 33 service-role boundaries

params.name: Desc
params.text:
• 100% RLS Adoption:
  All 104 base tables in the public schema have Row Level Security enabled (rls_enabled: true). Zero tables have open, unmanaged public access.

• 219 Defined RLS Policies:
  Fine-grained access control using auth.uid() and organization_id tenancy checks.

• 33 Service-Role Locked Tables:
  Tables with RLS enabled but 0 client-facing policies. These are entirely shielded from the Supabase Data API and accessible only via trusted backend workers.

• 28 Public / Anon Policies:
  Permits unauthenticated read access to public marketing assets (blog posts, authors, public pricing plans, newsletter signups).

params.name: Sub
params.text: Strict backend isolation: zero policies exist, blocking direct PostgREST client queries.

params.name: Recs
params.text:
1. Regular Policy Audit on Blog & Public Endpoints:
   Ensure blog_posts and newsletter_subscribers policies do not accidentally expose draft or subscriber PII to 'anon'.

2. Explicit Documentation of Service-Role Tables:
   Document the 33 service-role tables in code repository documentation to prevent frontend developers from attempting direct client reads.

3. Storage Object RLS Alignment:
   Confirm that storage.objects policies reflect the organization-scoped access model used in public tables.

params.name: Summary
params.text:
Strengths:
• 100% RLS compliance on all public tables.
• Clear multi-tenant relational hierarchy with organization_id.
• 215 properly declared foreign keys.

Areas for Improvement:
• 59 foreign keys missing indexes.
• Heavy log table bloat on email and SES webhook tables.
• 1 orphaned table missing primary key (test_apply).

params.name: Roadmap
params.text:
Phase 1: Immediate Wins (Week 1)
• Create B-tree indexes on high-traffic FKs: automation_waiting_events, campaign_run_audience, billing_addon_orders.
• Drop or migrate `public.test_apply`.

Phase 2: Data Lifecycle (Month 1)
• Establish automated 90-day retention policies on `ses_event_log` and `api_key_request_logs`.
• Evaluate table partitioning for `public.emails` as row volume grows.

Phase 3: Continuous Monitoring (Ongoing)
• Enable and monitor `pg_stat_statements` for slow query tracking.
• Perform monthly RLS policy audits on new tables.
